xBD building-damage chips (negative control)
Public source: xView2 / xBD dataset -- https://xview2.org/dataset
Reference: Gupta et al., "xBD: A Dataset for Assessing Building Damage from
  Satellite Imagery", CVPR Workshops 2019.

Usage in this study:
- 64x64 building chips from the Hurricane Harvey hold-out, binarized as
  damage-level >= 2. Used ONLY as a negative control (no AUROC lift expected),
  see artifacts/derived/strengthen_unambiguous/summary.json.
- The xBD imagery is redistributed under its own license; obtain it from the
  official xView2 site rather than from this repository.
